round: 4: SSMax with inverse head-width gain, retaining Q/K RMS
mathematical_motivation: The current real score envelope is (sqrt(d)/4)*log(N) at ideal initialization, so a constant multiplier does not give a constant envelope across widths. Set the fixed gain to1/d, giving abs(score)<=log(N) in real arithmetic. This is one common dimensional rule at every task size. It agrees with the ideal quarter-scale gain at d16, tightens it for d>16 and increases it for d<16. It is not a uniformly tighter bound at every width.
single_change: Replace the quarter-scale fixed gain g=(1/4)*exp(log_alpha)/d with g=1/d, where d is head width. Keep the visible-key log(N) multiplier and every other model/optimizer mechanism. Preserve original learned matrices, initialization draws, parameter count and original frozen buffers; any additional gain tensor is a deterministic nonlearned buffer.
equation: scores_ij = log(i+1) * dot(R_i RMS(q_i), R_j RMS(k_j)) / d, j<=i. Use global positions and full visible-key counts for every cached path.
invariants: Keep Q/K RMS, scaled Peri-RMS, embedding RMS, centered XSA, SwiGLU, ordinary fixed RoPE, tied weights, parameter-free normalization, all original tensors/RNG, LR x2, AdamW settings, data, model dimensions, batch order, cadence, thresholds and original update budgets.
scope: No LeRoPE, activation, residual, numeric arithmetic repair, optimizer or schedule change is combined with this trial. Parameter counts, all35tasks, frozen data, model sizes, seeds, shuffle, cadence and original budgets remain unchanged.
guarantees: For epsilon>0, d>0 and N>=1, the real normalized dot bound gives abs(score)<=log(N). Applying the checked selectivity ceiling gives p_i<=1/(1+(N-1)*N^(-2)), independent of head width; this is an upper bound and does not guarantee concentration. Query sensitivity constant is log(N)/(sqrt(d)*sqrt(epsilon)) for ideal exact gain. General statements with the actual rounded gain remain available. Establish explicit algebraic proof specializations and validate floating-point behavior separately. No whole-network, convergence or generalization theorem is inferred.
screen_policy: Require18/18passes and improved median paired epochs in at least3of6tasks versus the quarter-scale Q/K parent. Boolean AND,key-value binding and linear transport have head width16and are expected to be unchanged; the three width32tasks are the intended changed comparisons. Do not relax the gate after observing results. Preserve all rows, misses and errors; no screen geometric mean.
full_policy: If promoted, complete every75short cell before choosing. Select this new shared-model candidate only if all75pass and the complete geometric mean is below the quarter-scale parent. Otherwise retain the parent. Report every paired seed, per-task median/worst and parameter/runtime cost versus quarter-scale, LR x2, baseline and no-QK ablation. No successful-only aggregate.
long_policy: Freeze and commit a short-only decision after all promoted cells. If this new candidate wins, run it once at original budgets on the already observed30cell long diagnostic; otherwise do not duplicate the retained parent diagnostic. Long outcomes never choose or tune this or later candidates.
pretraining_validation: Verify the independent forward/gradient equation, same initialized matrices/RNG/capacity, Q/K RMS retention, N1 edge, causality and dense/chunked/shared cached computation, and native captured CUDA updates. Reuse the original trainer and scorer through explicit factories. Commit scientific source, settings and plan before new training.

score_stress.reference: Independent FP64 evaluation of the same quantized inputs and actual FP32 epsilon. Check the actual stored fixed gain and the normalized score envelope; isolate score arithmetic, without claiming that prior full-stack extreme failures are fixed.

source_policy: New implementation/configuration/plan files in a separate package, archived with all inherited scientific sources. Do not modify earlier scientific packages, plans, proofs, selections or results. Reporting code remains outside the new frozen training package.
not_used_for_design: Any long-suite outcomes. The rule follows the complete short comparison, width/selectivity mathematics and the shared-architecture instruction.
